plans.objective: Correct the Phase 252 failure shortlist through a separate, source-bound diagnosis and retain the original replay.
Reproduce the current registration failure with pinned tools and signal-driven controls, then fix only an established test or CI cause.
Make the internal release gate own the existing required unit smoke result.
Correct the browser skip inventory to describe what the workflow actually gates.
Validate five browser producer records and every selected native Playwright report before the aggregate can pass.
Wire the five browser producer records and native reports into the existing terminal required check.
Prove the browser gate on a bounded hosted fixture with real success, failure and cancellation outcomes.
Confirm required checks through normal PR CI and record exactly which reliability requirements the evidence proves.
Run the selected registration flow from a new bounded freeze and retain native receipts that can be checked independently.
Prove the readiness and isolation controls, then fix and repeat only a demonstrated registration cause.
Make a new hosted canary safe to launch by proving its request accounting, input sizes, and frozen identities locally.
Prove the repaired browser gate through a fresh bounded hosted fixture and independently checked outcomes.
Prove required checks on a normal production PR and prove docs-only classification on a separate real PR.
Record exactly what the recovery evidence proves and clear the old blocked-plan index only after both requirements are accepted.
